body.condition: For all hidden states \(s,s'\), if \(B_a(s,s)=B_a(s',s')\) for every \(a\in\mathcal Y\), then \(h_s=h_{s'}\).

novel.justification: The restriction says that observationally indistinguishable current regimes have the same adoption propensity. It holds when adoption responds to the current observable engagement profile rather than to distinctions that have no contemporaneous behavioral manifestation.
